prose: A small project, kept small so that everything in the report is about the case and not about the noise.
documents.title: Example

genome.hypothesis:
The tool is primed, and then the suite gets three more tests. No document was touched and no defect was repaired.

Any finding whose identity is derived from a sentence containing a measurement now has a different identity, because the measurement moved. The defect it describes is the same defect. A baseline can never match such a finding twice, so it is new every run, forever, and 'accept this finding' silently means 'accept it until the next commit'.
